name: no Video column: the icon stays in Recording
why: _eventRelColumns() never takes the icon out, so there is no Video column and the icon sits on every video recording's cell. Must fail on the Video test.

name: setlist recordings not deduplicated

name: header glyphs still release-tracks only
why: _initColHeaderGlyph()'s old gate: the cells lose their glyphs but no header gets one. Must fail on the glyph test.

name: cell glyphs not stripped
why: _eventStripGlyphs() returns its input: every header has its glyph and every cell still has its own too. Must fail on the glyph test's cell half.
grep: entity glyphs sit in the headers

name: the initial page is not repaired
why: Without the init-time call the native setlist keeps its "(with …)" artists as /work/ links until the button is pressed. Must fail on the initial-page test.

name: the converter does not repair a fetched setlist
why: Guard no fixture can see: event-overview is a single page, so the pre-processing block converts the LIVE document, which the init-time pass already repaired, and a second press reloads the page (init runs again). Only the fetch loop's `doc !== document` branch would hand the converter an unrepaired copy, and that branch never runs for this pageType today. The call stays as a guard for that branch (idempotent, one paragraph). A fixture that drove the fetch loop with a fetched page 1 would cover it.
